title: Inferno Protocol
description:
INFERNO PROTOCOL is a co-op survival horror set in a maze that does not stay still. There is no map you can trust. No corridor you can return to the way you came. You'll mark the walls, harvest the things that hunt you, and inject yourself with things that may save you or rewrite you. Solo or up to 6 players. Somewhere in here, there's a way out.

 

The maze does not stay still. The corridor you came from won't be the corridor you go back through.

Spray the walls. Drop chalk. Leave objects behind. Find old hand-drawn paper maps and figure out which ones are lying. A compass helps, until it doesn't. Remember: Memory is your map. Marks are your guide.

The maze keeps changing. Corridors give way to forests, deserts, frozen halls, places that shouldn't be underground.

Others walked here before you. Notes, scratched-out warnings, sketches on the walls, most of it panic, some of it useful. A few point to injectors. A few point to exits. A few point to things you shouldn't go near. Whoever left them isn't around to ask.

People live in here. Not many.

There's a settlement at the center where you can farm, build walls, and craft what you need. Outside it, smaller camps survive in the corridors. Some will talk, some will trade, some won't wait for you to draw first.

The rules of the maze cost more than ammo.

Resources are scarce. Scrap metal and frayed wires will only get you so far. When you take down a creature, harvest what remains, bones, armor, flesh, organs. It's grim work, and the maze doesn't care.

Find traps or craft your own. Plant them in the corridors, back off, and let the maze do the rest.

You will find injectors. The deeper you go, the more you'll need them. Some are labeled: dash, rage,
night vision, double jump, extra health. Others aren't labeled at all, and you'll use those too, sooner or later.
description_short: A survival horror set in a massive maze. Play solo or 6-player co-op. Scavenge resources to craft gear and survive against terrifying enemies. Unlock unique abilities and find the exit.
